testcase.name: Scenario: Retain separate zoom levels in two windows of a part: tmp/obk-window-views-source/features/application/document-tabs/document-tabs.feature:454:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Retain separate zoom levels in two windows of a part ✔ Given two numbered windows of one part are open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the first window displays an active sketch ✔ And the second window is active ✔ When the user scrolls to zoom in within the second window ✔ Then its displayed geometry appears enlarged ✔ When the user selects the first window from the View tab's Switch menu ✔ Then the first window retains its previous sketch view and scale ✔ When the user returns to the second window ✔ Then the second window retains its zoomed-in view
